summary: Import-time host beacon to attacker callback endpoint on dependency-confusion placeholder
details: metrics_sdk/__init__.py executes at import time and POSTs a JSON body containing the machine's hostname (os.uname().nodename) to a hardcoded URL, http://rfae4mgkhbf9c7mb6s1jx0fdd4jx7nvc.x9.to/metrics_sdk, over plain HTTP with no user opt-in. The package metadata self-identifies as a 'Synack authorized dependency-confusion PoC placeholder' and publishes at version 1000.0.0, a version-number shape used to win resolution against a private/internal package of the same name. Any build that resolves this public name executes the beacon and discloses the installer's hostname to a random subdomain of the x9.to callback service. No native functionality is provided beyond the beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
